---
title: "KPSS Test Report"
output:
  html_document:
    css: ../styles.css
  html_notebook:
    css: ../styles.css
params: 
  test_list: "[test_list]"
  output_dir: "[output_dir]"
  alpha: "[alpha]"
  include_description: TRUE
  include_details: TRUE
  include_code: TRUE
---

### KPSS Test

<!-- Render the test description. -->
```{r, child = if(include_description) 'kpss-description.Rmd'}

```

<!-- Render additional details about the test. -->
```{r, child = if(include_details) 'kpss-details.Rmd' }

```

<!-- Render the results over all splits. -->
```{r, echo = FALSE}

outputs <- character()

# Iterate through the list of locations and generate a report for each one
for (test in test_list) {
	env <- new.env()
	env$params <- c(list(output_dir = params$output_dir), test)
	outputs <- c(outputs, knit_child("kpss-results.Rmd", envir = env))
}

asis_output(paste(outputs, collapse = "\n\n"))

```

<!-- Include test code. -->
```{r, echo = FALSE, include = include_code } 
asis_output("#### Test Code") 
```

```{r, file = "kpss-test.R", include = include_code, eval = FALSE } 

```
